entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: This Criminal Petition is filed by the petitioner under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure to quash the proceedings against the petitioner, in FIR No.139 of 2019 on the file of Muppalla Police-Station, Guntur District.

The offences alleged are under Sections 188, 273, 420, 120 B of Indian Penal Code, 1860 and under Sections 58, 59 and 63 of the Food Safety and Standards Act,
2006.
Heard Sri Kambhampati Ramesh Babu, learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned Public Prosecutor appearing for the respondent-State.
Both the counsel agree that this matter is squarely covered by the judgment of the single Judge in the batch petitions bearing Criminal Petition Nos.3731 of 2018 and others.

In view of the fact that this matter is squarely covered by the earlier orders, the Criminal Petition is allowed and the proceedings against the petitioner in FIR No.139 of 2019, on the file of Muppalla Police-Station, Guntur District for the offences under Sections 188, 273, 420, 120 B of Indian Penal Code, 1860 and under Sections 58, 59 and 63 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, are hereby quashed.
As a sequel, miscellaneous petitions, if any, pending in this criminal petition shall stand closed.
D.V.S.S. SOMAYAJULU, J Date: 11.11.2019 GR Anjaneyulu Tallam vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh on 11 November, 2019 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/101443128/
